function.name: find_tables
function.description: Find table names in the current database. Use a short name fragment; empty finds an initial bounded list.

function.name: describe_tables
function.description: Read columns, primary keys and declared foreign keys for up to 8 exact table names. This does not read table rows.

function.name: propose_sql
function.description: Propose one complete replacement for the SQL editor only when the user explicitly requests writing or modifying SQL. Never executes SQL. Do not call for an explanation or example.
